svg.title: Engineering reference - source page 87
svg.desc: Source rainfall module: 800 × 800 mm; 304 stainless steel; 25 kg. Internal pressure/flow control supports even rainfall and prompt stopping. Controls include buttons, controller, touchscreen, expansion modules, relays, breakers, contactors, sensors, motor protection, wiring and enclosure. Film-timeline programming is project-specific. Reserve plant space by model; source arrangement places equipment no higher than the pool. Provide detailed pipework after design approval. Civil water/drainage works, ceiling, primary heat/water and treatment are outside the illustrated package unless agreed. Allow >50 cm around the pool for LED supports and cooling.
